tagline: 美能达便携相机，1992 年发布
description: 美能达于1992年推出的便携相机。配备35 mm f/4,5.。使用Automatic loading, advance and rewind.。感光度Crippled DX decoding; films below ISO 400 are exposed as ISO 100, those above as ISO 400. Non-DX films exposed as ISO 100.。Active infrared autofocus from 0,95 m to infinity.。

specs.对焦: Active infrared autofocus from 0,95 m to infinity.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in, auto-activated, non-cancellable. Range: 0,95–3,2 m. Flash ready LED signal.
specs.感光度: Crippled DX decoding; films below ISO 400 are exposed as ISO 100, those above as ISO 400. Non-DX films exposed as ISO 100.
specs.英文简介: The Minolta Riva AF 35, Freedom AF 35 in America or Mac 35 in Japan, is a cheap autofocus compact camera released around 1992[https://resolver.kb.nl/resolve?urn=ddd:010622646:mpeg21:p029 Objectief advertisement in Dutch newspaper "Leeuwarder courant", June 10 1992].
